description: Main window: native open/save dialogs plus the app's own commands. File reads and writes go through commands that check extensions; reports open from the app cache only (no opener permissions are granted to the webview); the meet store only touches the app data directory; serial access is limited to the CTS transport; Lane4 sign-in runs in Rust and its session token stays in the OS keychain; updates are checked and installed by Rust commands (the updater plugin grants the webview nothing).
